text:
mira: quick FYI 90m after the RBAC pruning we saw intermittent OCSP timeouts in ap-east-1 that caused cert stapling to drop for some frontends.

alice: are those related to keystore reads?

mira: probably multifactored: OCSP fetches are done by cert-manager which uses the same keystore proxy for fetching intermediate certs. when keystore reads failed, cert-manager couldn't assemble full chain and stapling failed.

ops-bot: incident detected: cert-staple-fail spike in ap-east-1 (2026-03-20T03:10Z)

nate: logs show: `ocsp: fetch failed: dial tcp 10.10.23.4:80: i/o timeout` and cert-manager fallback retried but hit KMS.Decrypt denies.

leigh: immediate mitigation: increase OCSP fetch timeout and enable local cert cache in cert-manager to reduce KMS dependence during bursts.

mira: good call. also schedule a cert-manager config update to prefer cached chains and mark local copies as authoritative for 1h.

alice: adding to infra-ops backlog. also question: our TLS cipher blacklist rollout next week 9need to ensure we don't block partners using RSA-SHA1 immediately. can we do per-region gradual enforcement?

nate: yes, canary configuration per region is supported by ingress config. we'll add per-region feature flags.

mira: final notes: keep audit retention PR separate; we need quick rollback paths for RBAC changes and an automated discovery script that enumerates service account annotations used by KMS paths.

leigh: I'll write that discovery script and wire it to the preflight.

mira: thanks. closing for now, reopen if staple errors resume.
